text:
[LTIM.2.5.3] A time-dependent condition that is **already true when its fact is
asserted** fires on the next pump, **if it still holds under that pump's
sample** ([LTIM.2.4.3]). [LTIM.2.4] / [LTIM.2.5] add re-evaluation on later
ticks; they do not delay a condition already satisfied when the fact arrives.
A condition the pump's sample finds false has ended its match
([LTIM.2.5.1]), and nothing fires.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_at_assert_fires_now
idris.note: A gate true at assert fires on the next pump. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_3__true_at_assert
idris.note: A condition already true at assert fires on that pump and never again: the tick after the assert makes nothing, so the firing is the activation the assertion made.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_3__fires_on_the_next_pump
idris.note: AND A CONDITION TRUE AT THE ASSERT FIRES ON THE NEXT PUMP with no tick between: the pump's re-time at the held sample decides it. '[LTIM.2.4] / [LTIM.2.5] ... do not delay a condition already satisfied when the fact arrives.' Executed: `[[(0, True)]]`.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_3__true_at_assert_decided_at_the_pump
idris.note: TRUE AT THE ASSERT, FALSE UNDER THE PUMP'S SAMPLE, NOTHING FIRES: the Ping asserted at 0 under `dwell < 2`, the clock advanced to 3, one pump -- logical/LTIM.2.5.3_true_at_assert_false_at_pump's `young`; and advanced to 1, the condition still holds under the pump's sample and it fires. 'If it still holds under that pump's sample'. Executed: `[[]]` and `[[(0, True)]]`.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_3__young
idris.note: A CONDITION TRUE AT THE ASSERT: `dwell < 2`, logical/LTIM.2.5.3_true_at_assert_false_at_pump's `young`. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_3__true_at_assert_fires_once_timed
idris.note: TRUE AT THE ASSERT, IT FIRES ON THE NEXT PUMP AND ONCE: both clocks advanced to 6 and a pump with no fact; the Ping asserted with the gate already open; an advance to 7 and a pump fire it; an advance to 8 and a pump fire nothing -- logical/LTIM.2.5.3_true_at_assert_fires_once's shape. The firing is the activation the assert made, which the tick from 6 to 7 finds open and leaves. Executed: `[[], [(0, True)], []]`.
